# Clipper2 2.0.1 (vendored)

Polygon clipping, offsetting and constrained triangulation by Angus Johnson — https://github.com/AngusJohnson/Clipper2,
tag `Clipper2_2.0.1`, folder `CSharp/Clipper2Lib`, unmodified. Boost Software License 1.0 (`LICENSE.txt`); `HashCode.cs`
carries its own MIT / BSD notices. Used by the door generator (House4696.Doors) for shaped glass, grooves and panels.
